name: NutriVerseAI
tagline: AI-powered meal planning, nutrition tracking, pantry and grocery management in one app.
description:
NutriVerseAI helps you eat well, waste less and cook with confidence. Plan meals on a calendar with calorie targets and dietary restrictions. Track calories, protein, carbs and fat against your own goals, with weekly trends and AI insights. Build grocery lists with smart substitutions, and keep a pantry that warns you before food expires. Manage your kitchen equipment with maintenance schedules and recipes that match the tools you own.

Create, fork and share recipes with nutrition data and sustainability scores. Keep a cooking journal that tracks how each recipe makes you feel. Explore cultural cuisines with authenticity scores, history, serving etiquette and traditional ingredient swaps.

Your data stays in your Anna account. AI suggestions use your Anna AI quota.
